parameters.content:
# ShiftHub — Monthly Hours Summary

On the 1st of each month at 08:00, totals confirmed hours per staff member for the PREVIOUS month (overnight shifts roll past midnight correctly).

- Writes one row per staff member to the MonthlySummary tab
- Emails the supervisor a full table report
- Emails each staff member their own hours (disable via Settings sendStaffCopies=no)
